documents.name: California Online Privacy Protection Act Notice

points.case_title: Tracking pixels are used in service-to-user communication
points.quote_text: We use pixels to learn more about your interactions with email content
points.title: Tracking pixels are used in service-to-user communication

points.case_title: First-party cookies are used
points.quote_text:
We collect data through cookies and similar technologies.

As further described in our Cookie Policy, we use cookies and similar technologies (e.g., pixels and ad tags) to collect data (e.g., device IDs) to recognize you and your device(s) on, off and across different services and devices where you have engaged with our Services. We also allow some others to use cookies as described in our Cookie Policy.
points.title: First-party cookies are used

points.case_title: This service receives your precise location through GPS coordinates
points.quote_text: We will ask you to opt-in before we use GPS or other tools to identify your precise location.
points.title: This service receives your precise location through GPS coordinates

points.case_title: Blocking first-party cookies may limit your ability to use the service
points.quote_text: Please note that if you limit the ability of LinkedIn to use cookies, you may worsen your overall user experience, since it may no longer be as personalized to you. It may also stop you from saving customized settings like login information.
points.title: Blocking first party cookies may limit your ability to use the service

points.case_title: Do Not Track (DNT) headers are ignored and you are tracked anyway even if you set this header
points.quote_text: With regard to DNT, LinkedIn currently doesn't respond to DNT signals in browsers because no DNT standard has been adopted, as noted above.
points.title: This service ignores the Do Not Track (DNT) header and tracks users anyway even if they set this header.

points.case_title: You must provide your legal name, pseudonyms are not allowed
points.quote_text: To use the Services, you agree that: (1) you must be the "Minimum Age"(described below) or older; (2) you will only have one LinkedIn account, which must be in your real name;
points.title: You must provide your legal name, pseudonyms are not allowed

points.case_title: This service is only available to users over a certain age
points.quote_text: The Services are not for use by anyone under the age of 16.
points.title: This service is only available to users over a 16 years old

points.case_title: You cannot distribute or disclose your account to third parties
points.quote_text: You agree to: (1) protect against wrongful access to your account (e.g., use a strong password and keep it confidential); (2) not share or transfer your account or any part of it (e.g., sell or transfer the personal data of others by transferring your connections);
points.title: You cannot distribute or disclose your account to third parties

points.case_title: There is a date of the last update of the agreements
points.quote_text:
User Agreement

Effective on November 3, 2025
points.title: There is a date of the last update of the agreements

points.case_title: You have the right to leave this service at any time
points.quote_text: If you wish to terminate this Contract at any time, you can do so by closing your account and no longer accessing or using our Services.
points.title: You have the right to leave this service at any time

points.case_title: No need to register
points.quote_text: If you have chosen not to register for our Services, you may access certain features as a “Visitor.”
points.title: No need to register

points.case_title: The terms may be changed at any time, but you will receive notification of the changes
points.quote_text: We may modify this Contract, our Privacy Policy and our Cookie Policy from time to time. If we materially change these terms or if we are legally required to provide notice, we will provide you notice through our Services, or by other means, to provide you the opportunity to review the changes before they become effective.
points.title: The terms may be changed at any time, but you will receive notification of the changes

points.case_title: Banned users are prohibited from creating a new account
points.quote_text: To use the Services, you agree that: (1) you must be the "Minimum Age"(described below) or older; (2) you will only have one LinkedIn account, which must be in your real name; and (3) you are not already restricted by LinkedIn from using the Services.
points.title: Banned users are prohibited from creating a new account

points.case_title: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and for the activities on your account
points.quote_text: You agree to: (1) protect against wrongful access to your account (e.g., use a strong password and keep it confidential);
points.title: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and for the activities on your account

points.case_title: You authorise the service to charge a credit card supplied on re-occurring basis
points.quote_text:
If your primary payment method fails, we may automatically charge a secondary payment method, if you have provided one. You may update or change your payment method. Learn more
  • If you purchase a subscription, your payment method automatically will be charged at the start of each subscription period for the fees and taxes applicable to that period.
points.title: You authorise the service to charge a credit card supplied on re-occurring basis

points.case_title: You are informed about the risk of publishing personal info online
points.quote_text: Please do not post or add personal data to your profile that you would not want to be publicly available
points.title: You are informed about the risk of publishing personal info online

points.case_title: You can opt out of targeted advertising
points.quote_text: You can opt out from our use of data from cookies and similar technologies that track your behavior on the sites of others for ad targeting and other ad-related purposes
points.title: You can opt out of targeted advertising

points.case_title: The service will resist legal requests for your information where reasonably possible
points.quote_text: We may dispute such demands when we believe, in our discretion, that the requests are overbroad, vague or lack proper authority, but we do not promise to challenge every demand
points.title: The service will resist legal requests for your information where reasonably possible

points.case_title: Alternative accounts are not allowed
points.quote_text: To use the Services, you agree that: (1) you must be the "Minimum Age"(described below) or older; (2) you will only have one LinkedIn account,
points.title: Alternative accounts are not allowed

points.case_title: Instead of asking directly, this Service will assume your consent to changes of terms merely from your usage
points.quote_text: Your continued use of our Services after we publish or send a notice about our changes to these terms means that you are consenting to the updated terms as of their effective date.
points.title: Instead of asking directly, this Service will assume your consent to changes of terms merely from your usage
